kv_cache.tooltip: Cache the reference tokens' attention K/V: they are precomputed in one t=0 pass and reused every denoising step, so the refs never ride along in the per-step sequence. The LoRA must be trained with ai-toolkit's kv_cache model kwarg for this to work properly. Leave off for normal edit LoRAs.

Krea2OstrisEditModelPatch.name: Krea2OstrisEditModelPatch
Krea2OstrisEditModelPatch.description: Enable reference latents on a Krea 2 model (index_timestep_zero method, as trained by ai-toolkit). Chain conditioning from TextEncodeKrea2OstrisEdit or Set Reference Latent nodes. kv_cache enables the cached one-pass reference mode; the LoRA must be trained with ai-toolkit's kv_cache option for it to work properly.
